name: Le Meridien Jakarta
short_description: Upscale business hotel in Jakarta's Sudirman CBD, opposite the World Trade Center and close to an MRT station. Known for a strong Club Lounge, attentive service and a broad breakfast, with rooms that read comfortable but somewhat dated.
ai_summary: Le Meridien Jakarta sits on Jalan Jenderal Sudirman in the heart of the Sudirman CBD, directly opposite the World Trade Center and a short walk from an MRT station, making it a practical base for business travellers. The property (opened 1992, rooms last renovated around 2018) carries a TripAdvisor rating of about 4.0/5 (roughly #147 of 686 Jakarta hotels, ~1,700 reviews) and around 8.6 on Booking.com. Independent reviewers and guest feedback consistently single out warm, attentive service and a well-regarded Club Lounge (20th floor) with a generous evening spread. The La Brasserie breakfast draws praise for variety, including a live Indian dosa counter, though a few reviewers feel food quality is merely average for the price. Rooms are clean and reasonably spacious but several guests and bloggers describe the hardware as dated, with dim lighting in places and an ageing gym; the outdoor pool is considered small for a hotel of this size. Location scores well for CBD convenience and MRT access, tempered by heavy Sudirman traffic and few walkable leisure attractions nearby. Overall a dependable, good-value upper-upscale choice for business stays.

faqs.question: How far is Le Meridien Jakarta from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK)?
faqs.answer: The hotel is roughly 26 km from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, typically a 40-45 minute drive depending on Jakarta traffic.

faqs.question: Is Le Meridien Jakarta close to public transport?
faqs.answer: Yes. It sits on Jalan Jenderal Sudirman opposite the World Trade Center and is within walking distance of a Jakarta MRT station, making the Sudirman CBD and nearby malls easy to reach.

faqs.question: Does Le Meridien Jakarta have a Club Lounge?
faqs.answer: Yes. There is a Club Lounge on the 20th floor offering breakfast, afternoon tea and evening cocktails; reviewers frequently rate it as one of the hotel's strongest features.

reviews.title: Review: Le Meridien Jakarta (Executive Suite)
reviews.author: Fai
reviews.summary: Booked a 75sqm Executive Suite on Bonvoy points. Praises attentive, elite-recognising service (10/10) and a strong Club Lounge (9/10). Notes the room feels dated with dark spots, an ageing gym and a small pool; still rates it high value.

reviews.title: Fascinating India: Le Meridien Jakarta Executive Suite
reviews.author: A. Wee
reviews.summary: Upgraded to a spacious Executive Suite with a large living room. Highlights attentive staff, complimentary fruit and water, a la-carte Club Lounge breakfast and a central location near WTC and malls; calls the rates fair value.
